title: Homomorphic Advantage Operator: Stabilizing Reinforcement Learning Under Fully Homomorphic Encryption Constraints
title_zh: 同态优势算子：在全同态加密约束下稳定强化学习

paragraphs.en: Privacy-preserving machine learning presents significant deployment challenges on the cloud for intelligent systems with confidential data. Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) offers a compelling solution for secure computation, preserving data confidentiality of cloud computations. However, applying FHE to reinforcement learning (RL) requires replacing non-linear operations with polynomial approximations, which diverge catastrophically due to a unique recursive error phenomenon known as the Bellman drift. This article introduces the Homomorphic Advantage Operator (HAO), a stabilization framework designed to prevent polynomial approximation divergence in FHE-based deep RL. HAO adapts the zero-mean centering projection from advantage-based value estimation directly to temporal-difference (TD) targets. This linear projection annihilates the uniform state-value baseline that drives the Bellman drift, maintaining per-state action rankings while requiring zero additional non-linear multiplicative depth and avoiding expensive ciphertext bootstrapping. The proposed HAO framework was evaluated using a three-tier experimental methodology, including a tabular Markov Decision Process (MDP), an encrypted CartPole environment using real CKKS cryptographic operations, and a 20-node logistics routing benchmark with dense continuous features. The results demonstrate that the proposed HAO strictly bounds network pre-activations within the safe polynomial approximation domain. The proposed HAO RL agents achieved 0% boundary breaches across all random seeds used, whereas regularization alone (L2 weight decay and gradient clipping) breached the bound on 3 of 5 seeds and the unstabilized baseline did so in 83.8% of episodes. Finally, HAO agents improve optimal policy accuracy by 18.0 percentage points in tabular domains and remain stable when DP-SGD-style Gaussian noise is added to the clipped gradients.
paragraphs.zh: 隐私保护机器学习在云端部署时，为包含机密数据的人工智能系统带来了重大挑战。 全同态加密（FHE）为安全计算提供了一种极具吸引力的解决方案，能够保护云端计算过程中数据的机密性。 然而，将 FHE 应用于强化学习（RL）需要以多项式近似替代非线性运算，而由于一种名为“贝尔曼漂移”的独特递归误差现象，这些近似值会灾难性地发散。 本文提出了同态优势算子（HAO），这是一种稳定化框架，旨在防止基于 FHE 的深度强化学习中多项式近似值的发散。 HAO 将基于优势函数的价值估计中的零均值中心化投影直接应用于时序差分（TD）目标。 这种线性投影消除了驱动贝尔曼漂移的均匀状态价值基线，在保持每个状态下动作排序的同时，无需增加任何非线性乘法深度，也避免了昂贵的密文自举过程。 本文提出的 HAO 框架通过三层实验方法进行了评估，包括表格马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）、使用真实 CKKS 加密运算的加密 CartPole 环境，以及一个包含密集连续特征的 20 节点物流路径规划基准测试。 实验结果表明，所提出的 HAO 能够将网络预激活值严格限制在多项式近似的安全域内。 在所有随机种子中，基于 HAO 的强化学习智能体均未发生边界突破；而仅使用正则化方法（L2 权重衰减和梯度裁剪）时，5 个随机种子中有 3 个出现了边界突破，未稳定化的基线模型则在 83.8% 的回合中突破了边界。 最后，HAO 智能体在表格域中将最优策略的准确率提升了 18.0 个百分点，并且在向裁剪后的梯度添加 DP-SGD 风格的加性高斯噪声时仍能保持稳定。

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful tool for optimizing complex, dynamic systems, from autonomous robotics to large-scale industrial supply chains and logistics [ 31 , 7 , 28 ] . However, as these intelligent systems are increasingly deployed in cloud environments, they face stringent data privacy and confidentiality requirements. In scenarios such as smart logistics routing, transmitting sensitive operational data, like proprietary demand forecasts, financial data, or real-time vehicle GPS coordinates, to centralized servers presents critical security vulnerabilities [ 18 , 17 ] . Recent work has shown that CKKS-based encryption can protect such location data in outsourced services such as ride-sharing and traffic management [ 33 ] . Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) offers a compelling solution to this privacy bottleneck by enabling computation directly on encrypted data [ 8 ] . Under an FHE paradigm, a client can encrypt their operational state and transmit ciphertexts to a cloud-hosted neural network, which then computes and returns encrypted policy decisions without ever exposing the underlying raw data [ 9 , 15 ] . While we refer to this broad paradigm as FHE, our practical implementation utilizes Leveled Homomorphic Encryption (LHE). By exploiting the fixed depth of the neural network architecture, LHE avoids the prohibitive computational cost of ciphertext bootstrapping, enabling efficient real-time policy evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 强化学习（RL）已成为优化复杂动态系统的强大工具，其应用范围涵盖自主机器人技术、大规模工业供应链和物流领域 [ 31 , 7 , 28 ] 。 然而，随着这些智能系统在云环境中部署日益广泛，它们面临着严格的数据隐私和保密性要求。 在智能物流路线规划等场景中，将敏感运营数据（如专有需求预测、财务数据或实时车辆 GPS 坐标）传输至集中式服务器会引发严重的安全漏洞 [ 18 , 17 ] 。 近期研究表明，基于 CKKS 的加密方法能够保护共享出行和交通管理等外包服务中的此类位置数据 [ 33 ] 。 全同态加密（FHE）通过在加密数据上直接执行计算，为这一隐私瓶颈提供了极具吸引力的解决方案 [ 8 ] 。 在 FHE 范式下，客户端可以加密其运行状态并将密文传输至云端部署的神经网络，该网络随后会计算并返回加密的策略决策，而无需暴露底层的原始数据 [ 9 , 15 ] 。 尽管我们将这一广泛范式称为 FHE，但我们的实际实现采用了分层同态加密（LHE）。 通过利用神经网络架构的固定深度，LHE 避免了密文自举所带来的高昂计算成本，从而实现了高效的实时策略评估。

paragraphs.en: We identify and formally define the Bellman drift as an RL-specific failure mode under FHE polynomial constraints, distinguishing it from the static approximation errors found in supervised learning literature.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将贝尔曼漂移识别并正式定义为在FHE多项式约束下的一种强化学习特有的失效模式，从而将其与监督学习文献中存在的静态近似错误区分开来。

paragraphs.en: We propose the Homomorphic Advantage Operator (HAO), a tripartite stabilization framework. It adapts the zero-mean advantage centering principle of Dueling architectures [ 32 ] , but shifts its application directly to the value recursion. Whereas dueling networks perform internal stream centering for network identifiability while still outputting full drift-prone Q Q -values, HAO applies a zero-mean linear projection matrix P P directly to the temporal-difference bootstrapping targets. This projection purges the uniform state-value baseline V ⁡ ( s ) V(s) from the recursive error loop, thus eliminating Bellman drift with no additional multiplicative depth. When paired with client-side reward scaling and decoupled weight decay, HAO strictly bounds pre-activations within degree-2 polynomial limits without requiring ciphertext bootstrapping.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了同态优势算子（HAO），这是一种三分式稳定化框架。 它借鉴了 Dueling 架构 [32] 中的零均值优势中心化原则，但将其应用直接转移到了价值递归中。 Dueling 网络虽然通过内部流中心化来确保网络可识别性，但仍会输出完整的、易受漂移影响的 Q 值；而 HAO 则将零均值线性投影矩阵 P 直接应用于时间差分自举目标。 这种投影将均匀的状态价值基线 V(s) 从递归误差循环中清除，从而在不增加额外乘法深度的情况下消除了贝尔曼漂移。 当与客户端奖励缩放和解耦权重衰减结合使用时，HAO 能够在不依赖密文自举的情况下，将预激活值严格限制在二次多项式范围内。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate through a three-tier experimental evaluation, including a tabular MDP, a CartPole environment using real TenSEAL CKKS cryptographic operations, and a single-depot capacitated routing benchmark, that the HAO framework achieves 0% boundary breaches, whereas regularization alone breaches the bound on 3 of 5 random seeds and the unstabilized baseline in 83.8% of episodes.

paragraphs.en: This section reviews the existing literature surrounding secure machine learning and cryptographic protocols. We categorize prior contributions into three distinct areas: techniques for managing polynomial activations under HE constraints, foundational cryptographic methodologies, and prior efforts in privacy-preserving RL. As summarized in Table 1 , while extensive research addresses stability in supervised learning and static inference, the unique challenges of applying FHE to RL remain unexplored.
paragraphs.zh: 本节回顾了有关安全机器学习和加密协议的现有文献。 我们将先前的研究成果分为三个不同领域：在 HE 约束下管理多项式激活的技术、基础加密方法，以及隐私保护强化学习方面的早期尝试。 如表 1 所示，尽管已有大量研究关注监督学习和静态推理中的稳定性问题，但将 FHE 应用于强化学习所面临的独特挑战仍未得到探索。

Subsequent work improved accuracy through self-learning activation functions (SLAF) [ 27 , 34 ] , HE-friendly training with knowledge distillation [ 4 ] , and boundary loss penalties with selective gradient clipping [ 3 ] . The ReBoot framework [ 26 ] enables fully encrypted training via depth-minimized architectures with CKKS bootstrapping.

paragraphs.en: Crucially, the previous stabilization methods are explicitly designed for supervised learning paradigms. Boundary loss penalties and SLAF rely on the assumption that target labels are static, ground-truth constants provided by a dataset. In RL, the agent generates its own dynamic targets via temporal-difference (TD) bootstrapping. The static training-time regularizers are insufficient to prevent the subsequent Bellman drift because the targets themselves are impacted by the polynomial approximation error.
paragraphs.zh: 关键在于，此前的稳定化方法都是为监督学习范式而明确设计的。 边界损失惩罚和 SLAF 都依赖于这样一个假设：目标标签是静态的、由数据集提供的真实值常数。 在强化学习中，智能体通过时序差分（TD）自举法生成自身动态的目标。 静态的训练时正则化项不足以防止随后的贝尔曼漂移，因为目标本身会受到多项式近似误差的影响。

paragraphs.en: The CKKS scheme [ 8 ] supports approximate arithmetic on encrypted real numbers, serving as the foundation for our continuous state-space operations. Alternate approaches include GAZELLE [ 15 ] , which combines HE linear layers with garbled circuits for exact non-linear operations, and Glyph [ 20 ] , which switches between CKKS and TFHE schemes to optimize different operation types. While mathematically robust, these mixed-protocol techniques incur significant communication and computational overhead, rendering them difficult to scale for highly sequential RL environments.
paragraphs.zh: CKKS 方案 [8] 支持对加密实数进行近似算术运算，为我们连续的状态空间操作奠定了基础。 其他替代方法包括 GAZELLE [15]，它将 HE 线性层与混淆电路结合，以实现精确的非线性运算；以及 Glyph [20]，它会在 CKKS 和 TFHE 方案之间切换，以优化不同类型的运算。 尽管这些混合协议技术在数学上具有稳健性，但它们会产生显著的通信和计算开销，因此难以在高度序列化的强化学习环境中进行扩展。

paragraphs.en: Prior work on privacy-preserving RL can be categorized into three distinct paradigms as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 关于隐私保护强化学习的前期研究可归为以下三种不同的范式：

paragraphs.en: (I) Several cryptographic data-protection approaches utilizing Multi-Party Computation (MPC) or Differential Privacy (DP) are proposed to protect distributed parameters. Namely, federated RL frequently deploys secure aggregation to mask client weight updates [ 6 ] , while DP-SGD bounds gradient privacy leakage [ 1 ] . Homomorphic encryption has likewise been used to protect gradients in distributed and federated deep learning [ 2 , 10 ] . However, these approaches do not provide a mechanism for an untrusted cloud server to compute policy forward passes directly on encrypted continuous state features.
paragraphs.zh: (I) 本文提出多种利用多方计算（MPC）或差分隐私（DP）的加密数据保护方法，以保护分布式参数。 具体而言，联邦强化学习通常采用安全聚合来隐藏客户端的权重更新 [6]，而 DP-SGD 则限制梯度隐私的泄露 [1]。 同态加密同样被用于在分布式和联邦深度学习中保护梯度 [2, 10]。 然而，这些方法并未为不可信的云服务器提供直接对加密后的连续状态特征执行策略前向传播的机制。

paragraphs.en: (II) A growing body of work explores direct evaluation on encrypted data. For example, Park et al. [ 25 ] proposed a privacy-preserving Q-learning framework using LWE-based FHE in cloud computing, validating feasibility on tabular problems but without neural-network function approximation or polynomial activations. Liu et al. [ 19 ] introduced the Preyer framework for dynamic treatment regimes, designing a plaintext length control protocol to manage bit-length overflow during repeated encrypted operations in small discrete state spaces. Jesu et al. [ 14 ] studied DQN training over AES-encrypted state inputs; notably, they evaluated homomorphic encryption (CKKS) but concluded that its computational latency was infeasible for iterative RL, falling back to symmetric block ciphers where performance collapsed on complex environments. Most recently, Nguyen et al. [ 24 ] introduced a groundbreaking privacy-preserving Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) framework using CKKS with full bootstrapping, achieving performance within 10% of plaintext baselines on CartPole and Pendulum cases. Their core innovation is an HE-compatible Adam optimizer that reparameterizes momentum to bypass high-degree polynomial approximations of inverse square roots. However, their framework requires high-degree minimax polynomials (degrees 15 and 31) and full bootstrapping (incurring ≈ 505 \approx 505 s per training step on CartPole), and does not analyze whether pre-activations remain within the polynomial approximation domain.

paragraphs.en: To overcome the theoretical limitations of standard regularization under FHE, we introduce a comprehensive architectural framework for privacy-preserving RL. First, this section formalizes the interaction between cryptographic mathematical constraints and the recursive nature of value-based learning; second, it introduces the Homomorphic Advantage Operator (HAO) to resolve these constraints, then proves its formal properties, and lastly outlines the client-server deployment architecture. Figure 1 provides a high-level overview of the proposed framework.

paragraphs.en: It is essential to distinguish the HAO projection from the advantage formulation in Dueling DQN [ 32 ] . Dueling networks decompose the internal neural network architecture into separate value and advantage streams, recombining them as Q ⁡ ( s , a ) = V ⁡ ( s ) + ( A ⁡ ( s , a ) − 1 | 𝒜 | ​ ∑ a ′ A ⁡ ( s , a ′ ) ) Q(s,a)=V(s)+(A(s,a)-\frac{1}{|\mathcal{A}|}\sum_{a^{\prime}}A(s,a^{\prime})) . While this achieves parameter identifiability, the final output Q ⁡ ( s , a ) Q(s,a) still retains the large, drifting V ⁡ ( s ) V(s) baseline, which amplifies the subsequent TD targets error. Moreover, implementing dual-stream branching architectures under FHE incurs significant cryptographic memory and routing overhead. In contrast, HAO operates on a standard single-stream network and applies the centering projection P P directly to the TD target computation ( y t = r t + γ ​ max a ​ Q ~ ​ ( s t + 1 , a ) y_{t}=r_{t}+\gamma\max_{a}\tilde{Q}(s_{t+1},a) ). By feeding strictly de-meaned advantage values into the recursive backup, HAO completely severs the positive feedback loop of the Bellman drift while consuming zero non-linear multiplicative depth.
paragraphs.zh: 必须将 HAO 投影与 Dueling DQN [32] 中的优势函数公式区分开来。 Dueling 网络将内部神经网络架构分解为独立的价值流和优势流，并将其重新组合为 Q(s,a)=V(s)+(A(s,a)-\frac{1}{|\mathcal{A}|}\sum_{a^{\prime}}A(s,a^{\prime}))。 尽管这种方法实现了参数可识别性，但最终输出 Q(s,a) 仍然保留了庞大且漂移的 V(s) 基线，这会放大后续的 TD 目标误差。 此外，在 FHE 下实现双流分支架构会产生显著的计算密码学内存和路由开销。 相比之下，HAO 基于标准的单流网络运行，并将中心化投影 P 直接应用于 TD 目标计算（y_{t}=r_{t}+\gamma\max_{a}\tilde{Q}(s_{t+1},a)）。 通过将严格去均值化的优势值输入递归备份过程，HAO 完全切断了贝尔曼漂移的正反馈循环，同时不消耗任何非线性乘法深度。

paragraphs.en: We consider a logistics company (client) outsourcing RL computation to a cloud service (server), see Figure 2 for a full illustration.

paragraphs.en: We adopt the standard honest but curious threat model used throughout the HE-ML literature [ 9 , 15 , 26 ] . According to this model, the server faithfully executes the protocol but may attempt to infer private information from the observed data. The primary privacy goal is data confidentiality, where the server must not learn the client’s raw states, Q-values, rewards, and actions.

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 4 , Figure 5 , and Figure 6 , under real CKKS arithmetic using a single hidden layer neural network, the standard Leveled HE (LHE) agent completely collapses. The pre-activations grow monotonically from an initial value of 2.44 to an explosive 28.68—a catastrophic breach of 5.7 × B 5.7\times B . This super-linear inflation directly triggers the polynomial approximation error loop formalized in Theorem 1, pushing gradient norms to 25,003 and rendering the agent numerically unstable, capping out at a maximum reward of only 28.0. Conversely, the pre-activations of the HAO-stabilized LHE agent never exceed 3.61, remaining inside [ − B , B ] [-B,B] throughout training, and settle at ‖ z ‖ ∞ = 0.57 \|z\|_{\infty}=0.57 by the final episode. This stabilizes the gradients and allows the agent to learn a functional policy (Max. reward 93.0), while the encrypted centering step ( [ [ Q ] ] ⋅ P [[Q]]\cdot P ) takes 1.64 seconds per episode on average. Crucially, in this experiment, the centering projection is applied server-side as a CxP operation ( [ [ Q ] ] ⋅ P [[Q]]\cdot P ), demonstrating that HAO is equally effective when performed directly on encrypted data.

paragraphs.en: To further evaluate HAO on a realistic, high-dimensional industrial task, we deploy a 20-node, single-depot, single-vehicle capacitated routing environment inspired by the Capacitated Dynamic Vehicle Routing Problem (CDVRP) formulation in RL literature [ 7 , 23 ] . Unlike the low-dimensional or sparse states of the tabular MDP and CartPole, this benchmark stresses polynomial activation bounds via an 8-dimensional dense continuous state space (encoding normalized vehicle coordinates, current and remaining customer demands, vehicle capacity utilization, visitation progress, time pressure, and distance to the nearest unvisited node) paired with a 6-action candidate dispatch space. Because all continuous input features activate simultaneously, they accelerate pre-activation accumulation. To rigorously test the robustness of the stabilization mechanisms, we inject a severe non-stationary environment shift at Episode 500. This shift scrambles the delivery demands and perturbs all node locations, delivering a sudden shock to the TD-targets. This forces the agent to rapidly adapt to a novel state distribution, thereby stress-testing the network’s susceptibility to catastrophic gradient explosion under sudden temporal difference errors. As in the tabular experiment, this ablation trains the FHE-compatible network (degree-2 activation) in plaintext; the encrypted forward pass is evaluated in the CartPole experiment.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在真实的高维工业任务中进一步评估 HAO，我们部署了一个由 20 个节点、单个仓库和单辆载重车辆组成的路径规划环境，该环境灵感来自强化学习文献 [7, 23] 中的载重动态车辆路径问题（CDVRP）模型。 与表格马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）和 CartPole 的低维或稀疏状态不同，该基准测试通过一个 8 维的密集连续状态空间（编码了归一化的车辆坐标、当前及剩余的客户需求、车辆载重利用率、访问进度、时间压力以及到最近未访问节点的距离），并结合一个包含 6 个候选调度的动作空间，对多项式激活边界施加压力。 由于所有连续输入特征都会同时激活，因此它们会加速预激活值的累积。 为了严格测试稳定化机制的鲁棒性，我们在第 500 轮中引入了一个严重的非平稳环境变化。 这一变化打乱了配送需求并扰动所有节点的位置，从而对 TD 目标造成了突然的冲击。 这迫使智能体迅速适应新的状态分布，进而对网络在突发时差误差下是否容易遭受灾难性梯度爆炸进行了压力测试。 与表格实验一样，这项消融研究以明文方式训练了兼容 FHE 的网络（2 阶激活）；加密的前向传播则在 CartPole 实验中进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Our findings also provide critical insight into the computational cost structure of recent encrypted RL architectures. Notably, Nguyen et al. [ 24 ] achieved encrypted deep RL by pairing an HE-compatible Adam optimizer with degree-15 and degree-31 minimax polynomial activations. paragraphs.en: It is worth noting that adaptive value normalization techniques, such as PopArt [ 11 ] , are widely used in plaintext deep RL to normalize targets across widely varying reward scales. HAO achieves an analogous stabilizing effect through a purely linear, additive projection matrix P P , serving as an HE-native counterpart to return normalization that incurs zero multiplicative depth.

paragraphs.en: The HAO framework is architecturally agnostic and inherently synergistic with DP. Because the centering projection is mathematically neutral and introduces no directional bias, the framework cleanly absorbs zero-mean Gaussian noise without destabilizing the polynomial bounds ( Table 5 and Figure 9 ). In our implementation, this supports two distinct privacy tiers: (1) CxP forward evaluation for maximum throughput, where the client keeps their state private; and (2) CxP combined with Gaussian noise on the weight updates, which, with per-example clipping and privacy accounting, can provide formal ( ϵ , δ ) (\epsilon,\delta) -privacy guarantees against gradient inversion attacks. Furthermore, the HAO centering matrix P P is a constant linear projection; therefore, it can be applied either on the client side or directly on the server without any additional ciphertext–ciphertext multiplication, meaning the mathematical framework theoretically extends to full Ciphertext-Ciphertext (CxC) evaluation for strict model confidentiality without increasing the polynomial degree overhead.
paragraphs.zh: HAO 框架在架构上具有中立性，并且与 DP 天然协同。 由于中心化投影在数学上是中立的，且不会引入任何方向性偏差，因此该框架能够干净地吸收零均值高斯噪声，而不会破坏多项式界限（表 5 和图 9）。 在我们的实现中，这支持两种不同的隐私级别：(1) CxP 前向评估以实现最大吞吐量，此时客户端保持其状态私密；以及 (2) CxP 与权重更新上的高斯噪声相结合，通过每个样本的裁剪和隐私计算，可针对梯度反演攻击提供正式的 (ϵ, δ) (\epsilon,\delta)-隐私保证。 此外，HAO 的中心化矩阵 P P 是一个恒定的线性投影；因此，它既可以在客户端应用，也可以直接在服务器端应用，而无需任何额外的密文-密文乘法，这意味着该数学框架理论上可扩展至完整的密文-密文 (CxC) 评估，以实现严格的模型机密性，同时不增加多项式次数的额外开销。

sents.en: In our implementation, this supports two distinct privacy tiers: (1) CxP forward evaluation for maximum throughput, where the client keeps their state private; and (2) CxP combined with Gaussian noise on the weight updates, which, with per-example clipping and privacy accounting, can provide formal ( ϵ , δ ) (\epsilon,\delta) -privacy guarantees against gradient inversion attacks.
sents.zh: 在我们的实现中，这支持两种不同的隐私级别：(1) CxP 前向评估以实现最大吞吐量，此时客户端保持其状态私密；以及 (2) CxP 与权重更新上的高斯噪声相结合，通过每个样本的裁剪和隐私计算，可针对梯度反演攻击提供正式的 (ϵ, δ) (\epsilon,\delta)-隐私保证。

sents.en: Furthermore, the HAO centering matrix P P is a constant linear projection; therefore, it can be applied either on the client side or directly on the server without any additional ciphertext–ciphertext multiplication, meaning the mathematical framework theoretically extends to full Ciphertext-Ciphertext (CxC) evaluation for strict model confidentiality without increasing the polynomial degree overhead.
sents.zh: 此外，HAO 的中心化矩阵 P P 是一个恒定的线性投影；因此，它既可以在客户端应用，也可以直接在服务器端应用，而无需任何额外的密文-密文乘法，这意味着该数学框架理论上可扩展至完整的密文-密文 (CxC) 评估，以实现严格的模型机密性，同时不增加多项式次数的额外开销。

paragraphs.en: While HAO successfully anchors the Bellman drift, our current implementation is constrained to a single hidden-layer network and a degree-2 polynomial activation. These constraints are strictly dictated by the restrictive multiplicative depth limitations inherent to the TenSEAL CKKS encryption scheme. Scaling this framework to deeper architectures or higher-degree polynomials will require the integration of FHE bootstrapping, a computationally expensive operation that remains a central challenge for cryptographic machine learning. Furthermore, while HAO expands the viable operational window for reward scaling, α \alpha remains an environment-specific hyperparameter that requires baseline calibration.

paragraphs.en: We identified the Bellman drift as a fundamental obstacle to deploying RL under FHE polynomial constraints and proposed the Homomorphic Advantage Operator (HAO) to solve it. Through centering TD targets with a zero-mean projection, HAO eliminates the persistent state-value bias that drives pre-activation growth. In empirical evaluations, HAO achieved 0% boundary breaches while regularization alone breached the bound on 3 of 5 seeds, and simultaneously expanded the viable operational window for reward scaling by 4 × 4\times . Because it requires no additional non-linear depth and is mathematically neutral, HAO is inherently HE-compatible and tolerates DP-style gradient noise. Thus, this makes it a highly practical and necessary component for privacy-preserving RL.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将贝尔曼漂移视为在 FHE 多项式约束下部署强化学习（RL）的一个根本性障碍，并提出了同态优势算子（HAO）来解决这一问题。 通过将 TD 目标以零均值投影进行中心化，HAO 消除了导致预激活值持续增长的稳定状态价值偏差。 在实证评估中，HAO 实现了 0% 的边界突破，而仅使用正则化方法时，5 个种子中有 3 个突破了边界；同时，HAO 还将奖励缩放的可行操作窗口扩大了 4 × 4\times。 由于 HAO 无需增加额外的非线性深度且在数学上保持中立，因此它本质上与 HE 兼容，并能容忍 DP 风格的梯度噪声。 因此，这使其成为隐私保护强化学习（RL）中一个极具实用价值且不可或缺的组成部分。

paragraphs.en: Future work must address the two primary frontiers of FHE-RL deployment: architecture depth and model confidentiality. Overcoming the strict multiplicative depth limits of shallow networks will require the integration of FHE bootstrapping, an open challenge that would enable scaling to deep, multi-layer topologies. For deployments requiring strict model confidentiality, extending the framework to Ciphertext-Ciphertext (CxC) evaluation is a natural next step. Because the HAO centering matrix P P is a constant linear projection that consumes no multiplicative depth, it can be seamlessly integrated directly onto the server’s ciphertext pipeline, making it perfectly suited for future CxC paradigms.
paragraphs.zh: 未来的工作必须解决 FHE-RL 部署的两个主要前沿领域：架构深度和模型机密性。 要克服浅层网络严格的乘法深度限制，需要整合 FHE 自启动机制，这是一个开放性的挑战，它将使得向深层、多层拓扑结构的扩展成为可能。 对于需要严格模型机密性的部署而言，将框架扩展到密文-密文（CxC）评估是顺理成章的下一步。 由于 HAO 中心化矩阵 P P 是一个不消耗任何乘法深度的恒定线性投影，因此可以直接无缝地集成到服务器的密文处理流程中，使其完全适用于未来的 CxC 范式。
